chunks: From him, from Ismail ibn Mihran, from Sayf ibn Amira, from the one who heard Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) saying:
The one who restrains his anger, Allah will veil his bareness.
ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual reward for controlling anger according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In al-Kafi, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) links the internal discipline of suppressing anger to the external manifestation of divine protection of one's 'awrah,' a concept encompassing both physical modesty and spiritual faults. This narration underscores the Shia emphasis on 'hilm' (forbearance) as a means to preserve dignity and avoid the exposure of one's vulnerabilities before others. The reward extends beyond mere emotional control to a tangible safeguarding of the self in both the physical and metaphysical realms.
